name: Underhand Lat Pulldown
cues: Lock your thighs under the pad
Grip the bar at shoulder width, palms facing you
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows travelling down by your sides
Let your arms straighten fully at the top

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-08 (bulk approval of wave 3a).
